events.title: Misery
events.description: **Step inside the chilling world of Stephen King’s _Misery_.** When celebrated novelist Paul Sheldon is rescued from a car crash by his "number one fan," Annie Wilkes, what begins as an act of kindness spirals into a terrifying psychological game. In this immersive production, the audience becomes part of Annie’s isolated mountain home, feeling every tense moment up close. Experience the claustrophobic suspense, shifting power dynamics, and shocking twists as Paul fights for his life…and his story. "Up close. Personal. Terrifying." \*Adult Content & Themes

events.title: Mean Girls: High School Edition
events.description: **_Mean Girls: The Musical_ brings the hilarious, razor-sharp world of high school drama to the stage, with a catchy pop score and plenty of pink.** Follow Cady Heron, the sweet new girl who suddenly finds herself in the jungle of teenage popularity ruled by the fierce and fabulous Plastics. Between burn books, backstabbing, and killer dance breaks, Cady must decide who she really is and just how far she’ll go to fit in. It’s hilarious, heartfelt, and totally _fetch_! “Sassy. Sharp. Unforgettable.”

events.title: The Drowsy Chaperone
events.description: **A musical within a comedy — and a cocktail of pure joy!** When a die-hard musical theater fan drops the needle on his favorite record, The Drowsy Chaperone magically bursts to life right in his living room. Suddenly, you're swept into a glittering 1920s musical full of tap-dancing gangsters, glamorous showgirls, and an overdramatic chaperone who loves her champagne almost as much as she loves meddling. It’s a laugh-out-loud love letter to golden age musicals — delightfully silly, endlessly charming, and guaranteed to leave you grinning from ear to ear. “Joyful. Hilarious. Sparkling.”

events.title: A Midsummer Night's Dream
events.description: **Step into the moonlit magic of the bayou, where jazz floats through the humid night and spirits dance among the cypress trees.** In this enchanting reimagining of Shakespeare’s classic, love triangles tangle, mischief brews, and magic lurks around every moss-draped corner. With voodoo charms and the haunting rhythms of early New Orleans, this _Midsummer_ invites you into a world where anything can happen under the spell of the moon. “Mystical. Haunting. Inventive”

events.title: Merrily We Roll Along
events.description: **Fresh from its smash-hit Broadway revival, _Merrily We Roll Along_ is a captivating and deeply moving story from legendary composer Stephen Sondheim.** This bittersweet musical rewinds the lives of three friends, tracing their journey from jaded success back to their starry-eyed beginnings. With a stunning score and a story full of humor, heartbreak, and hope, it’s a powerful reminder of how dreams change and how friendships endure. Don’t miss this once-overlooked gem that’s finally getting the recognition it deserves! “Heartfelt. Witty. Poignant.”
